groups.name: Few CSS transitions, no animations
groups.definition: Does the page define few or no CSS transitions and no CSS animations (minimal interactivity)?

groups.name: Lean self-contained markup, no scripts
groups.definition: Is the page markup lean and self-contained, with few elements, no or minimal scripts, and little or no inline styling?

groups.name: Frequent CSS grid layout use
groups.definition: Does the page use CSS grid for layout relatively often alongside flexbox?

groups.name: Small hand-written class set
groups.definition: Is styling done with a small hand-written set of classes rather than utility or framework classes?

groups.name: Many hover transitions
groups.definition: Do interactive elements use many CSS transitions for hover polish?

groups.name: Single embedded style, no effects
groups.definition: Is styling a single embedded style block with no inline styles, shadows, animations or transforms?
